content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: District Programme Officer, Hamirpur (ICDS) has officially released the Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 notification for the engagement of 80 Anganwadi Workers across eight project areas of Hamirpur district. The notification includes complete details regarding project-wise vacancies, educational qualification, age limit, eligibility conditions, residence requirements, selection process, merit and priority criteria, important instructions, and the online application process. content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should note the following dates for the Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026. All applications must be submitted online within this window; late or offline submissions will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Vacancy 2026 - Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 80 Anganwadi Worker posts are vacant across eight project areas of Hamirpur district, covering seven rural blocks and one urban (Shahar) area. The notification states that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on circumstances at the time of final selection.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply. The candidate must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward (urban area) for which the post is vacant. If no eligible candidate is available from that Gram Sabha, a permanent resident of the corresponding Nyaya Panchayat may be considered. Selection priority is also governed by a defined merit order relating to BPL status and marital condition (widowed/divorced/abandoned women), as detailed in the notification's Selection Priority clause.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Age proof will be accepted only as recorded in the High School mark sheet and certificate.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is merit-based, prepared using the candidate's educational qualification marks, combined with a defined priority order for BPL, widowed, divorced, and abandoned ("parityakta") women residing in the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward. No written examination or interview stage is mentioned in the notification. A detailed, category-wise priority sequence (categories I to VII) is laid out in the original notification for tie-breaking and preference among eligible applicants.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hamirpur Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official departmental website: http://upaganwadibharti.in Complete the online application form within the active window (27 August 2026 to 16 September 2026, midnight). Ensure all entered details, marks, and documents are accurate - the notification states candidates are solely responsible for any errors, and offline correction is not permitted. Candidates are advised to read the full government order dated 17 September 2025 before applying. Submit the form before the last date, as offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstance.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only online applications through http://upaganwadibharti.in will be accepted; offline forms are invalid. Residence and caste certificates must be digitally signed and online-verifiable copies issued by the competent authority. Income certificates must be issued at the Tehsil level as per the applicable government order and must be digitally verifiable online. No two women from the same family may be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Sahayika at the same Anganwadi center. Complete details of ward/village-wise vacancies and reservation are displayed on notice boards at the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil, and Block Development offices, along with the official website.

faq.question: Q1. What is Hamirpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Hamirpur (ICDS) to fill 80 honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakatri posts across rural and urban project areas of Hamirpur district, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 80 vacancies are available across eight project areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 16 September 2026, till midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (12th) or an equivalent qualification; higher qualification up to postgraduate level is considered for merit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the official website http://upaganwadibharti.in during the active application window; offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is merit-based on educational qualification, combined with a defined priority order for BPL, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women residing in the relevant Gram Sabha/Ward.
